description: The uninstall disable pass's pre hooks: PFB_PRE_UNINSTALL=1 and the pkg delete operation. A package lifecycle copies to the console exactly what the main log gets: the runner's lines and each hook's sanitised output, a failure included.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre Stop proxy (hook_pre_a.sh, timeout 60s)
stopping haproxy
esc \x1B[31mred\x1B[0m bad \xFF end
[ pfB Hook ] pre Stop proxy completed

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_b.sh, timeout 60s)
no newline[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 exited non-zero [ 3 ]; continuing
